findings.summary: Required payment fields have no visible required-state convention, and the tuition term is conditionally mandatory without a programmatically exposed required state.
findings.fix: Add a visible required cue or short form instruction identifying required fields. When a tuition fee is selected, expose the tuition-term field as required and state that it is optional for other fees.
findings.evidence: Fee, Amount, and Payment method used required; Tuition term did not, and there was no visible required-field convention.

findings.summary: Payment field errors render inline without a summary or focus target, so after submission users must locate each error in the reloaded form.
findings.fix: Render an error summary with links to affected controls, focus it after the response, and keep inline messages and their aria-invalid and aria-describedby associations.
findings.evidence: The controller populates paymentFieldErrors; the view rendered inline errors while the alert summary appeared only for paymentError.

passed: Payment and notification controls have programmatically associated labels and named submit buttons.
Payment field errors use aria-invalid and aria-describedby associations.
Notification actions provide status feedback and retry guidance for an expired security token.
notes: Autocomplete was reviewed; collected fields do not require standard personal-information or payment-credential autocomplete tokens.
